onset.Description: Seconds from the session clock origin.

event_id.Description: SSTIM session event type, the authoritative value.

sstim_hed_definitions.Description: HED definitions the HED column references. Not a column of events.tsv. Onset, Offset, Pause and Inset are scope tags requiring exactly one paired Def/, so the events do not validate without these in scope.

mod_frequency.Description: Modified frequency of the breath in hertz. This is a native column, not a BIDS-required duration column. The BIDS-required duration column is always n/a for this bundle.

SstimDurationConvention.Description: duration is always n/a in this bundle. SSTIM session events are instantaneous timeline marks, and inventing a duration would assert a span the native record does not contain. This is a note, not a redefinition of the BIDS-required duration column.

GeneratedHedColumn.Description: The events.tsv column named HED is generated from the native columns by the crosswalk, HED 8.4.0. Where an event changes a parameter, its Parameter-label and Parameter-value tags come from parameter_kind and value_after. SSTIM is canonical and HED is derived, so the native columns are the ones to read.
